message.content: {"recommended_method":"social_choice","consensus_potential":0.58,"fairness_assessment":"Social choice fairly compares visibility, recruitment, equipment quality, and budget sufficiency; the hybrid option offers balance but may underdeliver on both objectives.","conflict_severity":"medium","stakeholder_analysis":[{"agent":"agent_1","position":"Supports Option A: spend the full budget on an inter-city tournament to increase visibility and recruit members.","influence":0.3},{"agent":"agent_2","position":"Supports Option B: purchase new educational equipment because existing boards, clocks, and teaching materials are worn.","influence":0.4},{"agent":"agent_3","position":"Supports Option C: split the budget between a smaller tournament and educational equipment to balance outreach and pedagogy.","influence":0.3}],"recommended_resolution":"compromise","governance_reasoning":"A ranked social-choice vote should evaluate all three options against agreed criteria, while a compromise process can address the strongest concerns: verify equipment urgency and obtain realistic tournament and replacement-cost estimates before selecting a targeted allocation."}
